goal: Ensure transactional balance reconciliation and provide close_trade_and_credit_balance in SupabaseClient and bot engines

contracts.interfaces: close_trade_and_credit_balance function signature and balance credit integration
function_signatures: close_trade_and_credit_balance(self, trade_id: str, exit_price: float, exit_reason: Optional[str] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]

execution_steps: Write test in test_balance_reconciliation.py verifying close_trade_and_credit_balance updates trade and credits user balance
Run python test_balance_reconciliation.py to verify failure (red phase)
Connect close_trade_and_credit_balance in bot_engine.py for Grid and DCA bot TP exits
Run python test_balance_reconciliation.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: supabase_client.py provides close_trade_and_credit_balance closing the trade and crediting proceeds to demo_usdt_balance
bot_engine.py calls close_trade_and_credit_balance upon Grid Bot and DCA Bot TP sales, ensuring proceeds return to demo_usdt_balance
All existing unit tests pass without regressions

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- supabase_client.py bot_engine.py; rm -f test_balance_reconciliation.py supabase/close_trade_and_credit_balance.sql contracts/TSK-CLOUD-010.contract.json
